newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt names new chairman for holding company.
newsitem.headline: Egypt names new chairman for holding company.

text.p: The Egyptian government has appointed Moustafa Eid as chairman of the board of its Holding Company for Housing, Cinema and Tourism, newspapers said on Tuesday.
The dailies said Hamed Fahmy, the former chairman, resigned because of a dispute with Eid, who was the managing director.
Director of the company's privatisation sector, Mohammad Bakir, denied press reports, saying that Fahmy resigned to devote his time to his own construction consulting firm.
The holding company has 10 subsidiaries including Development Cairo Housing, Development United Housing, Film Theaters Misr Studios, and Light Misr Distribution.
